description.value: Your drone discharges electricity, dealing @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage in your choice of a @Template[cone|distance:15], @Template[emanation|distance:10], or @Template[line|distance:30]. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. Your drone can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Electrical Discharge]]{1d4 rounds}. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d6.
